2.12.22
Image.Tags
Applies to RDL 2013/01
The Image.Tags element supersedes the Image.Tag element of RDL 2011/01. The Image.Tags
element is optional and MUST NOT be specified more than once. If this element is specified, it is of
type Tags. The Image.Tags element is a collection of Tag elements. The value of each Tag element
MUST be a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) constant or an expression that evaluates to a
variant. The Image.Tags element contains a collection of arbitrary additional information about the
image that clients can use to perform custom processing.
Following is the parent element of the Image.Tags element.
Parent elements
Image
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Image.Tags element.
   <xsd:element name="Tags">
     <xsd:complexType>
       <xsd:sequence>
         <xsd:element name="Tag" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="1" maxOccurs="unbounded" />
         <xsd:any namespace="##other" processContents="lax" minOccurs="0"
                  maxOccurs="unbounded"/>
       </xsd:sequence>
       <xsd:anyAttribute namespace="##other" processContents="lax" />
     </xsd:complexType>
   </xsd:element>
